title: Minecraft Mods research catalogue
scope: Initial content import from gun research, broad mod recommendations and creature variety. Additional catalogues, HTML and documents remain to import. These records include mods, content packs, features and discovery routes. Owner-selected Forever World targets added separately from imported source observations. Storage and sorting master observations imported 2026-10-19; unresolved rows retained separately without guessed identity or fresh compatibility claims. Must-have/conversion source preferences and direct project routes imported 2026-10-19; unresolved rows preserved separately; starred source preferences do not imply native compatibility.

records.name: [TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero Guns
records.evidence: official artifact and isolated parser/Lua-hook checks; native game untested
records.reason: AAA-style gunplay, attachments, JSON gun packs, large creator ecosystem, active 1.20.1 branch.

verified.evidence: Official release metadata and archive hash checked; isolated parser and selected Lua-hook fixtures pass. Native Minecraft/gameplay/renderer compatibility remains untested.

records.name: Create Big Cannons
records.reason: Deep multiblock cannons/autocannons, projectiles, fuzes, kinetic loading and broad Create integration.

ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; Survival Progression; Forge 1.20.1; Mobs/Raids; Attachments

records.name: Create Big Cannons: Advanced Technologies
records.reason: Major Create Big Cannons expansion adding heavy/twin autocannon systems, additional cannon mechanics and rocket pods/rails; a core warfare addon rather than a discovery-only route.

records.name: Armed And Ready - VPB/PBJ addon
records.reason: Over 100 weapons with a Tarkov-like modular attachment system, caliber families, melee/bayonet support and survival/PvP balancing.

records.name: Vic's Point Blank
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; Gun Framework; Content Packs; Forge 1.20.1; Modern multi-loader

ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; VPB Continuation; Compatibility; Forge 1.20.1; Modpack Platform

records.name: Create: Immersive TaCZ Integration
records.reason: Automates guns, ammunition and attachments from the Create Armorer TaCZ pack through Create production chains, turning TaCZ into an immersive factory progression instead of a disconnected gun bench.

records.name: CBC Military Supplement

records.reason: Expands Create Big Cannons with torpedoes, torpedo tubes, bombs, rockets, projectile racks and a broad shell family for naval, anti-air and combined-arms builds.

records.name: Create: Love & War

records.name: Scorched Guns 2

records.name: [TaCZ] Call of Duty Warzone Gunpack

records.name: Dochi's Warfare
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #23 Creator Tool; NPC AI; Vehicles; Better Combat; Superb Warfare
records.reason: Extensive FPS map/server customization with client+server support; current 0.2.9 fixes Better Combat NPC animation loss and adds Superb Warfare 0.8.9.1 support.

records.name: [TaCZ/SBW] Combined Arms
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #5 Compatibility/Fix; #8 Mobs/Creatures; TaCZ; Superb Warfare; Simple Enemy; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Bridges TaCZ: Simple Enemy NPCs with Superb Warfare vehicles and turns the stack into a configurable combined-arms sandbox; 0.1.6 adds FOBs, helipads, optional generated structures, SBW grenades and map orders.

records.name: TaCZ Magazines
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ; Magazine/Ammo System; Forge/NeoForge 1.20.1; Beta
records.reason: Transforms TaCZ loose-ammo handling into a compatible magazine workflow for guns and addons, including generated magazines, reload-held selection, expanded magazines and workbench crafting.

records.name: Custom Gun Continued
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ Derivative; Forge 1.20.1 Beta; Future-Version
records.reason: Independent TaCZ-derived gun framework, Forge1.20.1 stable26.10.23 established, NeoForge26.3 BETA26.10.26 CF9204513 adds PlayerRevive bleed-state action restrictions; security patch verification remains essential.

records.name: TaCZ Armor Scaling
ecosystems: #12 Guns/Firearms; TaCZ; Armor/Ballistics; Server Balance; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Adds configurable linear armor damage reduction and armor durability-loss percentages specifically for TaCZ bullets, filling a useful survival/PvP balance gap without replacing the gun framework.

records.name: [TaCZ] Weapon Research & Blueprints
records.reason: Adds an exploration-and-research progression loop with blueprint discovery, research workflow and configurable recipe gating.

records.name: Don't Punch My TACZ
ecosystems: #3 Compatibility/Fix Mods; #12 Guns/Firearms; #26 Client-Side-Only; Punchy; TaCZ; Create; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Automatically prevents Punchy from fighting custom first-person renderers and fixes double-render/animation problems across TaCZ, Carry On, Create: Gunsmithing and related supported mods.

records.name: Jaam's Weaponry
ecosystems: #9 Combat/Animation; #12 Guns/Firearms; Forge 1.20.1; Epic Fight integration; Weaponry/RPG
records.reason: 96.7K+ download MIT project with 50+ weapons, mixed melee/firearms, attachment mechanics and a same-day 1.1.3 overhaul that materially improves Epic Fight compatibility.

records.name: TaCZ Hostiles
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ; Mobs/NPC Factions; Survival Encounters; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Adds two hostile armed factions and patrol-driven survival encounters; 1.1.3 adds native TACZ walk/aim/reload/fire animations, new faction guns, ammo-drop and targeting controls, patrol exemptions and movement fixes.

records.name: TACZ: Art of Sniping
records.reason: Adds extreme-distance target simulation, bullet drop, optional wind/humidity, scope telemetry, flyby/delayed-shot audio and a Tactical Collection Belt; technically novel but too young for broad promotion.

records.name: DoxBreath
records.reason: Hold a configurable breath key while ADS to suppress TaCZ sway, breathing wobble and part of camera recoil for a limited stamina window; 1.1.0 adds a configurable Lung HUD for drain/recovery; integrates TaCZ Additions when present.

records.name: TaczAttributeAdd
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ Addon; RPG Attributes; Forge 1.20.1; Current 1.21.1
records.reason: Adds a broad player/gun-stat layer across damage, headshots, recoil, spread, movement, magazine capacity, reload, melee, heat and related properties; same-day 1.4.2 refactors calculations to a stack-based ShooterContext for nested calls.

records.name: [TACZ Addons] Daffa's Arsenal
records.reason: Large immersive TaCZ military arsenal and attachment set; current 3.7.1.2 fixes third-person floating chain bullets on Machine Gun 338, RPD and MG3.

records.name: TaCZ Tweaks
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ Addon; Handling/QoL; Ballistics Compatibility; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: 7.3M+ mature original TaCZ addon with configurable piercing, bullet effects, sprint shooting/reload, balancing and explicit FirstAid/LSO/Valkyrien Skies/Immersive Vehicles compatibility.

records.name: [TACZ] Enchanted Arsenal
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ Addon; Enchantments; Magic; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Adds eight gun enchantments and two curses for TaCZ firearms; established 1.3M+ download progression layer.

records.name: TACZ: Durability (Timeless and Classics Guns)
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ Addon; Durability/Jamming/Repair; Datapack; Forge/NeoForge 1.20.1
records.reason: 6.3M+ mature MIT addon with data-driven damage/recoil/RPM/ADS/ammo-speed/inaccuracy modifiers, jamming/repair and attachment durability.

records.name: Armor Reinforcement [Tacz]
records.reason: Adds configurable protective layers to armor via a cutting-table style workflow; high concept fit but zero downloads at verification and exact file ID unresolved.

records.name: [TaCZ] Juggernaut Armoury
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ Addon; Ballistic Armor; Plates; Hit-Position Protection; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Reads TaCZ weapon data for armor protection and insertable plates.

records.name: Warium
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #11 Technology/Automation; Warfare; Cannons; Explosives; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: >1.0M project downloads; 1.3.5 Oct12 new parachutes/nuclear explosion overhaul, long-range particles experimental; full existing arsenal persists.

records.name: Valkyrien Warium
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #10 Movement/Transport; Vehicles; Valkyrien Skies; Warium Addon; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: 378K+ download bridge that turns Warium + Valkyrien Skies into a direct vehicle-warfare stack with propulsion, aerodynamics and controls.

records.name: Warium Additions
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #11 Create/Technology; Automation; Integration; Energy/Fluid/Item Transport; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: 50K+ MIT addon that bridges Warium energy/fluids/machinery into Create, Immersive Engineering, Supplementaries and adjacent tech.

records.name: Warium: Futurism
records.reason: Oct12 0.0.3 bug and crafting fixes, new nuclear weapons, balancing; exact base pin and game QA pending.

records.name: Tacz-Animation-Additions
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #9 Combat/Animation; #6 Gameplay/QoL; TaCZ Addon; Stances; Third-Person Animation; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Adds a unusually broad tactical handling layer around TaCZ: reload-key ammo inspections, numeric ammo HUD, prone crawling, holster/draw and directional third-person motion, high-ready, muzzle obstruction, door kick/open, under-door inspection and optional status HUD.

records.name: TaCZ: Presence
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #9 Combat/Animation; #6 Gameplay/QoL; TaCZ Addon; Immersion; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: High-adoption TaCZ feedback layer adding suppression, directional hit indicators, scope glare, muzzle smoke, tactical HUD alerts and visual/audio impact feedback.

records.name: Action Bar by Karl Karlmann
ecosystems: #36 Hotkey/Keybind/Configuration; #29 Client QoL/UI; #26 Client-Side-Only; #27 World-Safe; TaCZ Compatibility; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Client-only routing layer that compresses mod abilities into three action slots and gained TaCZ keybind support in 1.0.2; current 1.0.5 uses standard game key routing.

records.name: [TaCZ] Warden & Sculk Gun Detection
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #6 Gameplay/QoL; TaCZ Addon; Sculk/Warden Integration; Server-Side; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Lightweight logical-server bridge: unsilenced gunfire emits EXPLODE while silenced gunfire emits quieter PROJECTILE_SHOOT, allowing vanilla Wardens and Sculk Sensors to react naturally.

records.name: [UNOFFICIAL]TaCZ Refabricated
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; Future Versions; TaCZ Port/Derivative; Fabric; 26.3
records.reason: Unofficial modern Fabric TaCZ framework and gunpack port. Oct15 Fabric26.2 R3-hotfix3 fixes compatibility with newer JEI and bullet-hole orientation; distinct Sep30 Fabric26.3 R1-hotfix preserves earlier fixes. Neither is Forge1.20.1.

records.name: Scorched Guns 2 0.5.5 Unofficial port
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #25 Future-Version; Unofficial Port; NeoForge 1.21.1; Create/Touhou Little Maid Integration
records.reason: Keeps 141-gun Scorched 0.5.5 ecosystem for NeoForge1.21.1. New Oct16 1.0.4 registers automatic and burst-beam firing modes (datapack/addon opt-in) and improves dynamic mob-type classification. Original Forge1.20.1 remains distinct.

records.name: TACZ Ammo Drops
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ Addon; Ammo Economy; Survival/QoL; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Small focused TaCZ sidecar that returns the exact ammo type used to kill hostile mobs; 1.2.0 adds configurable drop chance and min/max counts and advertises automatic custom-gunpack support.

records.name: 〖TACZ-Addon〗Wall-displayed Guns with High Fps!
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #6 Gameplay/QoL; #12 Building/Decoration; TaCZ Addon; Armory Display; Rendering QoL; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Converts TaCZ guns into recoverable static display blocks that retain original gun, attachment and ammo data; 0.6.28 adds mesh-model compatibility for broader gunpack support.

records.name: [SBW] Superb Warfare
records.reason: Same-day 0.8.9.2 bug-fix release keeps SBW one of the strongest standalone combined-arms alternatives without changing TaCZ's overall ecosystem lead.

records.name: TACZ Unified Ammunition
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; TaCZ; Superb Warfare; Warium; Compatibility Bridge; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Reduces duplicated ammunition/material silos in mixed TaCZ/Warium/SBW packs.

records.name: SBW Optimized
ecosystems: #4 Performance/FPS; #26 Client-Side-Only; #27 Update-Friendly/World-Safe; #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; Superb Warfare; Rendering/Mesh; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Client-only SBW sidecar that accelerates freeform mesh rendering with VBO caching and provides the current mesh path used by compatible SBW addons while upstream native poly_mesh support is absent.

records.name: CGC Compat: Shader
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #5 Compatibility/Fix; #26 Client-Side-Only; Custom Gun Continued; Oculus/Iris; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Explicitly targets Custom Gun Continued with Oculus on 1.20.1 and Iris on 1.21.1+, filling a high-value renderer compatibility gap now that CGC has a Forge 1.20.1 beta.

records.name: CBC: Warium Projectiles
records.reason: Adds a mature 14+ projectile/ammunition family to Create Big Cannons using Warium content, including conventional, incendiary, cluster, gas, fission/fusion, rocket and mortar ordnance.

records.name: TaczCurios
ecosystems: #40 Guns/Firearms/Ballistics; #6 Gameplay/QoL; RPG/Equipment; Curios; TaCZ; Forge 1.20.1
records.reason: Six TaCZ Curios slots/attributes; update candidate 1.4.16 (Oct14) replaces 1.4.13 catalogue. Prior 1.4.13 fixes buffs, absorption, Lootr and Blank Sword; new changelog unverified. Copy-world and back up player/equipment data.

records.name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ NeoForge Port
records.reason: Carries the TaCZ gun ecosystem to NeoForge 1.21.1; same-day r7 fixes bullet crash/render bounds, backports a vulnerability fix and slightly optimizes code.

records.name: TaCZ Pack Upgrader
